name: Trello
label: Trello REST API
description: Trello REST API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/trello/api_spec.json). Official Trello REST. Auth is query key+token (token is the secret; key is a config string on every op via queryFrom). Atlassian developer terms. Official docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Trello official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"board_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'board_create', 'board_get', 'board_update', 'board_delete', 'list_create', 'list_get', 'list_cards', 'list_update', 'list_archive', 'card_create', 'card_get', 'card_update', 'card_delete', 'comment_create', 'comment_update', 'comment_delete', 'checklist_create', 'checklist_get', 'checklist_delete', 'label_create', 'label_add', 'label_remove', 'attachment_add', 'attachment_list', 'attachment_delete', 'member_add', 'member_remove', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'board_create'.

schema.label: due
schema.description: Card due datetime ISO8601. card_create / card_update. Example: 2026-01-20T17:00:00.000Z. https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-cards/

schema.label: pos
schema.description: Position on the list/board. card_create/update and list_create. Accepted: top | bottom | a positive number. Example: top.

schema.label: idMembers
schema.description: Comma-separated member ids to assign. card_create / card_update. Example: 51e5...,51e6...

schema.label: idLabels
schema.description: Comma-separated label ids to attach on card_create. Example: 51e5...

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: board_create, board_get, board_update, board_delete, list_create, list_get, list_cards, list_update, list_archive, card_create, card_get, card_update, card_delete, comment_create, comment_update, comment_delete, checklist_create, checklist_get, checklist_delete, label_create, label_add, label_remove, attachment_add, attachment_list, attachment_delete, member_add, member_remove, listen. Default: board_create. Example: board_create.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=query (configKey token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Trello API key (query param key). Required with token. Example: 'a1b2c3…'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
